title: The grapes
subtitle: Grenache and its partners
objectives: Name the southern Rhône's main grapes

steps.title: Grenache leads
steps.body: Grenache is the main red grape, loving heat and drought, giving red fruit, spice and high alcohol. Syrah adds colour and structure; Mourvèdre adds tannin and savoury, gamey notes; Cinsault adds perfume and lightness, especially in rosé. Carignan also appears. Blends of Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre are called GSM.

steps.title: Whites
steps.body: White grapes include Grenache Blanc, Clairette, Roussanne, Marsanne, Bourboulenc and Viognier. White wines are a small share, about 7%, but growing. They're rich, with stone fruit, herbs and moderate acidity. Châteauneuf-du-Pape Blanc is the most famous.

steps.prompt: Match each grape to its role.

steps.body: Côtes du Rhône red must be mainly Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre. It's one of France's best everyday reds.

steps.explanation: GSM is Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Grenache leads, with Syrah, Mourvèdre and Cinsault
GSM blends balance fruit, colour and structure
Whites are a small, growing share
